<documents>
<document id="travel-dcc">
PayingˆinˆlocalˆcurrencyˆorˆdollarsˆAbroad,ˆcardˆterminalsˆandˆATMsˆsometimesˆofferˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆinsteadˆofˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆThisˆisˆcalledˆdynamicˆcurrencyˆconversion.ˆItˆsoundsˆconvenient,ˆbutˆit'sˆalmostˆalwaysˆmoreˆexpensive.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆchooseˆAlwaysˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆThenˆtheˆconversionˆhappensˆatˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrate,ˆplusˆyourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆdollarsˆcostˆmoreˆIfˆyouˆpickˆUSˆdollars,ˆtheˆmerchantˆorˆATMˆownerˆconvertsˆtheˆamountˆusingˆitsˆownˆrate,ˆwhichˆusuallyˆincludesˆaˆmarkup.ˆYourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆmayˆstillˆapply,ˆbecauseˆtheˆmerchantˆisˆstillˆabroad.ˆ##ˆOnlineˆshoppingˆForeignˆwebsitesˆsometimesˆshowˆpricesˆinˆdollarsˆusingˆtheirˆownˆconversion.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆswitchˆtheˆsiteˆtoˆitsˆhomeˆcurrency,ˆthat'sˆusuallyˆcheaper.ˆ##ˆAlreadyˆpaidˆinˆdollars?ˆDynamicˆcurrencyˆconversionˆisn'tˆaˆreasonˆtoˆdisputeˆaˆpurchase,ˆbecauseˆyouˆagreedˆtoˆitˆatˆtheˆterminal.ˆNextˆtime,ˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="atm-abroad">
UsingˆATMsˆabroadˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆworksˆatˆATMsˆabroadˆthatˆacceptˆVisa.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆfeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆTheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆreplacesˆtheˆout-of-networkˆfeeˆforˆwithdrawalsˆoutsideˆtheˆUS.ˆTheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawals.ˆItˆonlyˆappliesˆtoˆpurchases.ˆTheˆATMˆownerˆmayˆaddˆitsˆownˆsurcharge.ˆPremiumˆsurchargeˆreimbursementˆcoversˆATMsˆabroadˆtoo,ˆupˆtoˆtheˆsameˆmonthlyˆcap.ˆ##ˆPickˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆIfˆtheˆATMˆoffersˆtoˆconvertˆtheˆwithdrawalˆintoˆUSˆdollarsˆforˆyou,ˆdeclineˆandˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆTheˆATM'sˆrateˆisˆusuallyˆworseˆthanˆtheˆnetworkˆrate.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆWithdrawalsˆabroadˆcountˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆdailyˆATMˆlimitˆasˆwithdrawalsˆatˆhome.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆATMˆkeepsˆyourˆcardˆFreezeˆtheˆcardˆinˆtheˆappˆstraightˆawayˆandˆreportˆitˆlost.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆaskˆforˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆabroad.ˆEveryoneˆelseˆcanˆuseˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆaˆmobileˆwalletˆuntilˆthey'reˆhome.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="savings-tax-forms">
TaxˆformsˆforˆinterestˆIfˆyouˆearnˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆduringˆaˆcalendarˆyear,ˆweˆsendˆyouˆaˆFormˆ1099-INT.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆavailableˆByˆJanuaryˆ31ˆofˆtheˆfollowingˆyear.ˆYou'llˆfindˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆTaxˆforms.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆwhenˆit'sˆready.ˆ##ˆEarnedˆless?ˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆlessˆthanˆtheˆthreshold,ˆweˆdon'tˆsendˆaˆform,ˆbutˆtheˆinterestˆisˆstillˆshownˆonˆyourˆmonthlyˆstatements.ˆYouˆmayˆstillˆneedˆtoˆreportˆit.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆandˆbonusesˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆaren'tˆinterestˆandˆdon'tˆappearˆonˆtheˆform.ˆReferralˆbonusesˆmayˆbeˆreportedˆseparately.ˆ##ˆTaxˆquestionsˆWeˆcan'tˆgiveˆtaxˆadvice.ˆForˆquestionsˆaboutˆhowˆtoˆreportˆinterest,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆtaxˆprofessional.ˆ##ˆWrongˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆformˆIfˆyourˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆonˆtheˆformˆisˆwrong,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆChangesˆtoˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆgoˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
